objective: bound practical performance at declared fixed geometry, resolution and constraints; do not equate a failed run with a 3DGS representation limit
protocol_authority: this parent governs future execution; earlier child CPU plans/targets remain preparation evidence, not authorization. In particular the color-certificate q is explicitly D_color below, while source target NPZ retain full D

canonical.init: old S2 shader c0, not the striped direct-C final
fixed: opacity and tangent/normal scales in color-only pair
canonical.guard: existing r4 maximum-footprint 38982 active-row guard plus original protected/near guards; conservative constraint explicitly reported

domains.A: real visible road, with target shadow contamination excluded
domains.C: legal physical road hole, independent of F0 color validity
domains.S: target-associated high-confidence shadow interior inside original 2D teacher write domain
domains.U: unqualified shadow boundary/ambiguous association, not ground truth
domains.K: retained objects; predicted non-target shadow conflicts separately protected

check1.shadow_policy: reuse frozen p>=0.6/u<=0.35 and2px boundary exclusion; full4x4 native footprint; binary eligibility q is not calibrated correctness
check1.eligibility: actual future A_seen or S_seen may update effective known RGB; C-only trusted-known remains protected. Immutable measured/prior ledger never overwritten
check1.disjoint_losses: A/C/S independently normalized; outside preservation excludes their full authorized coverage, not only high-alpha photo masks
check1.full_denominators: full S, boundary, no-geometry, projection-protected and low-alpha pixels remain separate reported denominators
check1.conflict: same-world cross-view teacher disagreement reported separately from real A disagreement; no hidden-road or de-shadow GT claim
check1.next_native_gate: actual S_seen gradient and K constraints; full-S maximum-allowed opacity/absolute-scale controllability before interpreting color failures
check1.stop_rule: missing teacher, conflicting ownership/target, no writable S contribution or unresolved coverage cannot justify a larger generator

check2.target: independent analytic asphalt/paint evaluated on frozen G_s mesh ray hits; never GS self-rendering as truth
check2.camera_role: all five supervised for this oracle; not novel-view generalization
check2.geometry_missing: 218 fixed mesh-miss pixels remain in full38416 report with declared plane fallback. Exact-G_s38198 and fallback strata separate; fallback mismatch cannot certify a representation failure
check2.opacity_strata: soft premultiplied color feasibility is interpreted only on pre-frozen exact-G_s and reference-alpha>0.9 stratum. Full38416 still reports gaps/thin/support and the opaque-target range floor; alpha0 making both sides0 is never success
check2.coverage_floor: for opaque ideal T and black-background nonnegative native weights, 0.5*mean(max(T-alpha_ref,0)^2) is a conditional coverage-range floor; native operator assumptions must be revalidated after GPU authorization
check2.detail: known curve/width/period/phase, flat-top paint with fixed soft edge; projected width, dash-on and dash-off each>=3px as predeclared resolvable stratum; subpixel stress never a failure criterion
check2.operator: fixed native premult RGB is affine in bounded independent road ci; native linearity/adjoint must be verified after user GPU authorization
check2.objective: 0.5 times fixed-q weighted mean RGB squared premult error on D_color=D_full & exact-G_s & alpha_ref>0.9; q=1 on D_color and0 elsewhere. f, gradient and FW gap use this identical fixed q and denominator3*sum(q); primary edge weight0; no RGB/alpha
check2.color_certificate_domain: positive feasibility and negative RGB certificate both use the same D_color, not the whole exact-G_s stratum. Full38416/exact38198/fallback218 and gap/thin remain separately reported. Counts in check2/color_strata_receipt.json; opaque coverage-floor target is separate
check2.certificate: for feasible ci in[0,1], FW gap=sum(gi*ci-min(gi,0)); f*=between max(0,f-gap) and f. Use numerical safety margin1e-5 after native linearity/adjoint validation. CPU toy validates the math only
check2.conclusion_rule: a feasible output meeting RGB and detail criteria witnesses capacity. A certified RGB-objective failure requires L_safe=max(0,f-gap-1e-5) strictly above the registered objective tolerance; small gap alone is insufficient. Bounds straddling tolerance, optimizer plateau or time cap mean inconclusive. RGB optimality alone cannot prove an arbitrary nonlinear detail metric impossible
check2.numeric_certificate_gate: native objective plus box-gradient error contribution must have a conservative combined bound<=1e-5; native linearity/adjoint spot checks alone do not establish this bound. If not established, no negative certificate and the result remains inconclusive

error_envelope.interpretation: engineering reference levels, not universal perceptual equivalence or an automatic model-switch threshold

check2.conditional_scope_relaxation: if protected-color floor dominates, a separately tagged virtual road-only all-color oracle isolates this constraint; no geometry edits and never production promotion

check3.init: both corrections zero on exact common c0; same masks/targets/scope/sampler/coverage/operator/optimizer/budget
check3.scope: new V4 actual alphaT requalification required; historical78421-row basis preview is not a training authorization
check3.RGB: clip(c0+delta,0,1), native sRGB appearance; W4 continuous correction and identical frozen-row overrides saved separately
check3.node_bound_boundary: I0 row-delta box is redundant for [0,1] c0 shader reachability; W4 node box can reduce attainable clipped shared-field colors. This is the declared bounded W4 method, not an unconstrained continuous-field capacity claim. Do not attribute a W4 failure solely to basis or generative prior without separating this constraint floor
check3.prior_normalization: same effective row RGB mean in both arms, not mean over their different parameter counts
check3.coverage: fixed old S2 for primary color comparison; low-coverage full-S pixels remain a separately reported limitation, not color-fit failures

joint_gate.teacher_A_C_S_noninferiority: W4 no more than I0 +1/255 absolute MAE per domain/frame
joint_gate.directional_striping: on one pre-frozen baseline-alpha-qualified mask, E=mean absolute vertical second difference RGB. Compare excess E_I0-E_c0 and E_W4-E_c0; target>=50% reduction only if I0 positive excess exists. Nonpositive excess is not-applicable and does not establish shared necessity. Report both axes, delta-energy and native crops; detail/fit gates also required
joint_gate.details: check ideal resolvable paint and trusted real visible detail; C/S do not supply hidden-road GT or unknown dash phase
joint_gate.persistence: actual native reload maxRGB/alpha<=1e-6; RGB8 separately

conditional_I_reg.rule: only if needed to distinguish basis sharing from simple regularization; fixed world-neighbor TV(delta) weight.02, no real-data spacing/LR sweep
conditional_I_reg.interpretation: if regularized independent RGB also succeeds, shared atlas is not proved necessary

check3.clip_boundary: shared W4 with clipping is not the independent-ci box-LS global certificate

TRELLIS_decision.current: not justified as a drop-in switch by existing evidence
TRELLIS_decision.conditional_pilot: only after supervision/coverage problems are separated, ideal GS capacity is established, and residual real-material failure motivates a stronger joint spatial prior
TRELLIS_decision.promotion: requires positive small held-out fixed-geometry material adaptation comparison against incumbent, matched legal information/regions and explicit cost/detail/K checks
TRELLIS_decision.no_automatic_zero_shot_veto: historical one zero-shot negative does not rule out post-training
TRELLIS_decision.no_model_size_as_fix: missing/conflicting targets or fixed-operator bandwidth limits are not repaired merely by model size
TRELLIS_decision.model_role: generative material prior may coexist with3DGS renderer; no need to regenerate already trusted road geometry

runtime_gate.next: wait for user to enable and explicitly resume GPU work; then revalidate environment, inputs, actual gradients, safe coverage, save/eval/fullresume/next-stage entry
runtime_gate.long_runs: if a later run is expected to exceed one hour, first complete about10min real GPU lifecycle smoke; CPU tests never substitute
